rcls_cr02h.why: Each slot's class word (rcu_dec_pkg::rcu_cls) straight from rcu_isd's flops, loaded in A-1 from the slot's lead fields (RA-43; one shared capture, RI-25), wire only; fanout is check-ngd's. This ends RA rev 117's interim on the opcode's class decode.

kv_cr01h.by: RI, under AR 336 (b) and RA rev 127; fanout term, AR 326, RA rev 106
kv_cr01h.why: kill_v_q straight from ccv_rcu's kill detector flop (on the ungated clock, so a kill landing while RCU sleeps is seen in K), wire only; the fanout term across rcu_mig and rcu_kill is check-ngd's at the block read (RA rev 126 (b)).

kmn_cr02h.by: RI, under AR 338 and AR 339; fanout term, AR 326, RA rev 106
kmn_cr02h.why: kill_warp_mask straight from ccv_rcu's kill detector flop (a plain flop on the ungated clock, RCU's boundary flop for the input, AR 338), wire only, read only with kact_cr02h (kill_v_q a cycle on); the arrival is the fanout term, as kv_cr01h's.
